name: What if my bathroom is on a slab foundation?

mainEntity.name: What if my bathroom is on a slab foundation and I want to change the layout?
mainEntity.text: What if my bathroom is on a slab foundation and I want to change the layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathrooms on slab foundations can still be remodeled successfully, but layout changes require more planning because the plumbing is harder to move. If a drain, toilet, or shower location changes, the contractor may need to cut and patch the slab, which adds labor, noise, dust, and cost. This is why many slab-based remodels focus on improving the room without relocating every fixture. If the goal is a more functional layout, it helps to identify which changes deliver the biggest benefit for the least plumbing disruption. Homeowners should also expect longer lead time for structural and plumbing coordination. A layout that looks simple on paper may be significantly more expensive once the foundation is considered.
acceptedAnswer.description: A slab foundation makes bathroom layout changes more expensive because moving drains or toilets may require cutting concrete. The best layouts on slab homes usually keep major plumbing close to existing locations when possible.
